description: Developer debug modal that displays the document's canonical JSON along with optional runtime, DOCX DrawingML metadata, and recovery-detail JSON sections, with copy and close actions.

parameters.name: DocxDrawingMetadataJson
parameters.description: Optional JSON with the current runtime debug state.

parameters.name: OnClose
parameters.description: Raised when the user requests copying the debug JSON payload.

parameters.name: OnCopyJson
parameters.description: Optional JSON with the latest runtime recovery detail.

parameters.name: RecoveryDetailJson
parameters.description: Optional JSON with imported/exportable DOCX DrawingML metadata.
